title: Hold a licence for pesticide work
what: Carry out prescribed pesticide work (such as commercial pest control) only under a licence for that kind of work, and engage only licensed agents.

sources.title: Pesticides Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out prescribed pesticide work unless the person is the holder of a licence that authorises the person to carry out that kind of work.
